parameters.help_en: The ID of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs)
parameters.name: network_interface_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the instance resides
parameters.name: ens_region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security group to which the secondary ENI belongs. Specify this parameter if you want to query the information about secondary ENIs by security group ID
parameters.help_zh: 辅助网卡对应的安全组ID。 如果您需要通过安全组ID查询辅助网卡的信息，请指定该参数

parameters.help_en: The primary IP address of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs)
parameters.name: primary_ip_address

parameters.help_en:
The type of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs). Valid values:
Primary: primary network interface controller (NIC).
Secondary: secondary network interface controller (NIC).

Default value: empty, which indicates that all types are queried
parameters.help_zh:
弹性网卡类型。取值范围：
Primary：主网卡。
Secondary：辅助网卡。

默认值：空，表示查询所有类型
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The name of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs)
parameters.name: network_interface_name

parameters.help_en:
The stateful status of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs). Valid values:

Available: available.
Attaching: attaching.
InUse: in use.
Detaching: detaching.
Deleting: the delete operation is in progress.

Default value: empty, which indicates that all statuses are queried
parameters.help_zh:
弹性网卡的状态。取值范围：

Available：可用。
Attaching：附加中。
InUse：已附加。
Detaching：分离中。
Deleting：删除中。

默认值：空，表示查询所有状态
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The page number of the instance status list. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 实例状态列表的页码，起始值为1。                              默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging queries. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值为100，默认值为50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The IPv6 addresses of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs). N indicates the settings for multiple IPv6 addresses. Valid values of N: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 弹性网卡的IPv6地址。N表示可以设置多个IPv6地址，N的取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: ipv6_address

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the ENS edge zones. N indicates the sequence number of the edge zone ID. Valid values of N: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: ENS节点ID列表。N表示可以设置多个节点ID，N的取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: ens_region_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of IDs of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs). N indicates the settings for multiple elastic network interfaces (ENIs) IDs. Valid values of N: 1 to 100
